# MoreFiles <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MoreFiles:Int32 dir:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | In | Int32 | required | A folder handle from `ReadDir`. |

**Returns:** 1 if more entries follow, 0 if not. Undocumented in the official help.

## Description

Tells whether `NextFile` has another entry in a folder opened with `ReadDir`.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
dir = ReadDir(".")
n = 0
While MoreFiles(dir)
	NextFile$(dir)
	n = n + 1
Wend
CloseDir dir
Notify n + " entries"
```
